new_description: A small, silent illusion shimmers into being, real enough to fool a passing glance.
You beckon nearby water to rise, part, or swirl at the flick of your hand.
Lightning crawls over your hand, and whatever you touch is jolted by a crackling thunderbolt.
Under your palms, solid stone softens like clay and takes whatever form you press into it.
A gust lifts you off your feet and sets you down gently anywhere within 30 feet.
A bead of hissing green acid flies from your fingers and splashes across your foes.
A spectral, bone-cold hand clutches a foe and drains the warmth of life from it.
Tiny floating lanterns of soft light bob and drift wherever you guide them.
You read the wind for weather, coax a bud to bloom, or stir the leaves with a whisper of the wild.
A crackling beam of raw otherworldly force tears out from your outstretched hand.
A mote of fire leaps from your fingertip and bursts against your target.
A gentle touch steadies an ally's focus just when they need it most.
You touch an object and it glows with a warm, steady light like a hearth lantern.
A faint spectral hand appears to lift, pull, and carry things at your direction.
Broken things knit back together under your touch, leaving no scar or seam.
Your whisper rides the air to a distant ear, and their reply finds its way back to you.
A puff of sickly green vapor bursts from your palm and chokes the air around a foe.
Small, harmless wonders bloom at your fingertips: sparks, scents, chills, and tidied dust.
A flickering flame blooms in your open hand, ready to light the dark or be hurled.
A pale blue ray of bitter cold lances out and slows whatever it touches.
A brief touch leaves an ally wrapped in a faint shield against harm.
Pure radiance pours down on a foe like the first light breaking through the clouds.
Your staff or club swells with the strength of old oak and strikes with nature's weight.
Lightning crackles across your hand and jolts whoever you touch.
You steady a dying creature, holding its fading life in place.
The ground trembles, flames flicker, and your voice booms with the weight of the heavens.
You glimpse a foe's next move a heartbeat before it happens.
Your words cut sharper than steel, laced with magic that stings the mind.
A little glamour makes a stranger warm to you, until the spell fades and they realize it.
A tiny star falls and clings to a creature, outlining it in light so it cannot hide.
An invisible ward hums across a doorway or camp, waking you when anything crosses it.
You speak soothingly to a wild creature, and it comes to see you as a friend.
A pall of bad luck settles over your enemies, making every effort falter.
A warm glow settles on your allies, guiding their blows and steadying their nerve.
Fire sprays from your spread fingers in a roaring sheet.
A creature suddenly sees you as a trusted friend, at least for a while.
A dazzling spray of colored light leaves those in its path reeling and blind.
You speak a single word laced with power, and a creature obeys.
Strange words and foreign letters unravel into meaning before your eyes and ears.
Clean water pours from nowhere, or a pool of water vanishes into mist.
Your touch closes wounds and eases pain with soft, warm light.
You feel the presence of otherworldly beings, holy or unholy, lurking nearby.
The glow of nearby magic becomes visible to you like faint auras in the air.
You sense sickness and poison, seeing them as a faint, sour shimmer.
Your appearance shifts like a mask, changing your face, clothes, and form.
Your weapon glows with fervor, each blow searing with radiant power.
Weeds and vines burst from the ground, coiling around anything nearby.
Your legs blur with speed, letting you dash away in the blink of an eye.
Shimmering light outlines your foes, leaving them nowhere to hide.
